_meta.keys: tutorials: Pandaborn.Tutorial.<tutorial id> (the tutorial's name); stages: Pandaborn.Tutorial.<stage id> (the stage's intro). Step texts are the game's own. The generator looks entries up by id, so an entry no stage uses is ignored.
_meta.style: Vanilla tutorial intros are one or two short sentences that say why, not how (the step line says how, with its own numbers). One idea per stage. Building, plant and good names are capitalized, as in the vanilla tutorial. No days or amounts beyond what a recipe panel shows.
_meta.order: Stages are listed in the order of play decided on 2026-11-25 (DESIGN.md): logs first, then water and food, poles, dens, a cistern, the inventor, the Steamer, the hammock and the bell, flumes, the Moon Loft, and tea last. No intro names something a later stage teaches. If catalogue/tutorial.toml changes the order, reread the chain.

PandabornRicePaddy, PandabornLanternFestival (names written by the catalogue lane: review them) and the stages PandabornTutorial.Paddy and PandabornTutorial.FestivalSquare (the former drafts stage_paddy and stage_festival) were added the same day.

stages.PandabornTutorial.Lumberjack: Every village is built from Logs. Lumberjacks cut the trees you mark.
stages.PandabornTutorial.Water: Pandas need water every day. A Water Pump keeps drinking water coming.
stages.PandabornTutorial.Gatherer: Berries keep the village fed until the first field is ready. A Gatherer Flag sends someone to pick them.
stages.PandabornTutorial.ShootBamboo: Shoot Bamboo is the first crop. A Farmhouse plants it on green ground, and the shoots are ready in a few days.
stages.PandabornTutorial.PoleMill: Inkpaws build with Poles. For now, a Pole Mill splits Logs into Poles. It needs power: a Power Wheel beside it will do.
stages.PandabornTutorial.FirstPoles: Most buildings need Poles. Let the mill build up a stock.
stages.PandabornTutorial.TimberBamboo: Soon the Poles will grow by themselves. A Forester plants Timber Bamboo, and lumberjacks cut it straight into Poles, with no mill.
stages.PandabornTutorial.Dens: A Den is a home for a small family. Pandas sleep better under a roof, and cubs are born there.
stages.PandabornTutorial.Cistern: Sooner or later the river stops. A Small Cistern keeps water for the dry days: build one before the first drought.
stages.PandabornTutorial.Inventor: Most buildings must be unlocked with Science Points. An Inventor produces them, slowly and lying down.
stages.PandabornTutorial.Steamer: A Steamer makes two helpings from every raw shoot, and a cooked dish is a small pleasure of its own.
stages.PandabornTutorial.Hammock: When the working day ends, pandas look for somewhere to rest. A Hammock gives one of them a daily nap.
stages.PandabornTutorial.Bell: The afternoon bell ends the working day. Ring it earlier: rested Inkpaws work and walk faster, so a shorter day gets as much done and the afternoon is free.
stages.PandabornTutorial.ScoopWheel: Inkpaws would rather lead water than hold it back. A Scoop Wheel stands in a current and lifts water up the bank, with no workers.
stages.PandabornTutorial.Flume: Run Flumes from the wheel across dry land. Water follows the arrows, level or downhill, and the ground beside a flume turns green.
stages.PandabornTutorial.MoonLoft: A lantern in a high window is an old invitation: your first Moon Loft brings a Ringtail family. Inkpaws work from dawn to the bell. Ringtails work from the bell to dawn.
stages.PandabornTutorial.TeaGarden: Tea Bushes grow only on dry, brown ground, well away from water. The Forester plants them and a Gatherer picks the leaves.
stages.PandabornTutorial.Roastery: A Tea Roastery roasts the Tea Leaves into Tea.
stages.PandabornTutorial.Tea: Tea keeps in any warehouse. Build up a small stock before you open a Teahouse.
stages.PandabornTutorial.Teahouse: Tea is drunk at the Teahouse and nowhere else. It needs a stock of Tea and Water, and serves pandas off duty.
stages.PandabornTutorial.Paddy: Rice grows only in a flooded field. Close a field in with Levees, place a Paddy Spout on its edge with water behind it, then build a Paddy House and plant Rice.
stages.PandabornTutorial.FestivalSquare: A village needs something to look forward to. Build a Festival Square: its panel shows what the district must have in store before the Lantern Festival can be called.

drafts._note: Not shipped: no stage or key uses these yet. They are the wording worth keeping from the retired messages.json (deleted 2026-11-25), corrected against the build, for stages and loading tips the catalogue or code lanes may add. Each is one idea in the voice of the stages above.
drafts.stage_first_drought: Your village has come through its first drought. Bamboo and cabbage stop growing when the ground dries and start again when the water returns. Droughts grow longer: build more cisterns.
drafts.stage_cistern_tap: In a drought, a Cistern Tap pours stored water into a flume and keeps the ground beside it moist.
drafts.stage_dry_stone_wall: Moisture spreads through the ground. A Dry-Stone Wall stops it, so tea can grow near wet fields.
drafts.tip_flume_strip: Tip: The ground beside a <YellowHighlight>Flume</YellowHighlight> stays moist. A flume and a row of bamboo is the simplest farm there is.
drafts.tip_dry_ground: Tip: <YellowHighlight>Tea Bushes</YellowHighlight> and <YellowHighlight>Sichuan Pepper</YellowHighlight> need dry ground. Water that reaches their roots kills them.
drafts.tip_hard_staple: Tip: Cabbage lasts longer without water than shoot bamboo. Plant both before the first drought.
drafts.tip_night_builders: Tip: With a <YellowHighlight>Night Builders' Post</YellowHighlight>, construction carries on from the afternoon bell to dawn.
drafts.tip_flowering: Tip: A <YellowHighlight>Great Flowering</YellowHighlight> is announced a full cycle ahead. Use the time to store food or poles.
drafts.game_start_notification: Found bamboo and water. A good place for a village.
drafts.new_village_flavor: And though the village fell silent, the water ran on down the flumes.
